title: Zero-Exploration Exact-Anchor Briefings, Task-Check CLI & Sync Subagent Execution
content: Deep behavioral forensics across recent agent sessions revealed 3 major efficiency leaks: (1) Implementers viewing 13-26 files (exploration ratio 3.7x-10x) before editing due to missing symbol/line anchors in briefings; (2) Implementers running 7-14 raw bun test commands locally due to lack of a fast type/lint pre-validation CLI; (3) Subagents making up to 82 manage_task polling calls due to async command launch. Interventions: (a) Enforce exact-anchor compilation in queue:next/dispatch; (b) Add bun harness.ts task:check for fast incremental type/lint check without test execution; (c) Mandate WaitMsBeforeAsync: 10000 in agent instructions to eliminate polling.
